comment.narrative: Project established and supported a working group comprised of experts from legal community civil society national parliament and the Ombudsperson Office to coordinate efforts for improvement of access to justice by persons in situation of vulnerability in civil cases. By December 2022 the project jointly with the working group held eight focus group meetings with more than 75 representatives from civil society lawyers Ombudspersons Office Ministry of Justice Bar Association National Parliament and academic institutions to discuss the current status and effectiveness of the access to justice by persons in situation of vulnerability. As a result project jointly with the working group completed the drafting of a report with recommendations which provides guidance and recommendations for improvement of access to justice by persons in situation of vulnerability in civil and administrative cases. The concept presents modalities for delivery of legal aid in civil cases identifying services that fall under statepaid legal aid and the persons eligible to receive these services. Additionally it provides information on alternative funding sources for provision of legal aid in civil cases. The concept proposes probono legal services as an effective tool for improvement of the access to justice by persons in situation of vulnerability. In 2023 project will finalise the concept and recommendations with in consultation with representatives from relevant state authorities and the parliament and advocate for its consideration in legislative level.
